tasks.title: Disk loading
tasks.solution: A = 4·π·(D/2)², D = d·0.0254 m; loading = m·g/A. The lower it is, the less power goes into each unit of thrust.

tasks.title: Thrust from the coefficient
tasks.solution: T = C_T·ρ·n²·D⁴, with n in rev/s and D in meters; divide by g and convert to grams. Thrust grows as the square of RPM.

tasks.title: Ideal hover power
tasks.solution: P = T^1.5 / √(2·ρ·A), where A is the total disk area. Real power is 1.5–2 times higher because of prop and motor losses.
